messages:
Maria G: Quick sync — we need a concise handoff checklist for SIs doing co-sell with our HW partners + cloud marketplace listings. Sales asks for a single page they can copy into their playbooks.
Tom K: +1. Do we want separate flows for marketplace-led vs SI-led leads?
Maria G: Yes — marketplace leads should stay with marketplace AE unless SI already has an active TOI. SI-led should route to SI AE but we need account mapping rules.
Jake L: Proposed mapping: SI owns any account where they have active contracted services or a signed MSA in last 12 months. Otherwise marketplace/sales owns.
Anya P: That sounds fine. Need an exceptions channel for contested accounts. Maybe a weekly triage with SI AM + partner rep.
Maria G: Agreed. Also need required artifacts on handoff: 1) Account owner + contact list 2) TOI summary (workloads + infra) 3) Expected timeline and decision criteria 4) Any compliance concerns (VPC/KMS)
Tom K: Add: marketplace listing SKU + estimated monthly spend. That helps justify Dedicated capacity offers.
Jake L: + mention HW partner discounts or referral credits if applicable. Those change rules of engagement for pricing conversations.
Anya P: For routing rules, suggest this algorithm snippet we can paste in playbook:
```
if SI_has_active_MSA(account) or SI_contracts_services(account):
    route = "SI-AE"
else if lead.source == "marketplace":
    route = "Marketplace-AE"
else:
    route = "Sales-RM"
```
Maria G: Perfect. Also need escalation path: contested within 48h -> partnership-triage slack + weekly call if unresolved. If high-value (>$200k ARR) auto-escalate to GTM lead.
partners-bot: Reminder: new Marketplace partner onboarding checklist updated: https://redwood.example/marketplace-onboard (doc). :calendar:
Tom K: One more — joint announcement planning. If SI wants a co-announce we require: joint case study draft, logos approved, joint PR contact, 2-week review lead time.
Anya P: Put that in the playbook under "Joint comms" with required legal signoffs.
Jake L: Action items: Maria to draft single-page handoff checklist; Tom to add marketplace SKU/finance fields; Anya to draft triage schedule; I'll add MSA detection logic to CRM.
Maria G: Timeline: draft by EOD Friday, review Monday sync, publish to partners playbook by Wednesday.
Tom K: Sounds good. I'll ping the HW partners for any special handoff fields they need (serials, warranty IDs) and add to checklist if needed.
Anya P: I'll spin up the weekly triage invite and add a rotating chair.
Maria G: Thanks all — will post the one-pager here when ready. :thumbsup:
